verdict.rationale: QuickBooks ships a built-in 'Intuit Intelligence' chat assistant that users can delegate tasks to directly (create invoices, run payroll, generate reports, resolve anomalies, forecast) per first-party docs, plus a dedicated Payroll AI agent. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the assistant's task delegation actually working in practice, and detail on scope/limits of what it can autonomously execute.
